what: Lookup tables of the HTW Berlin Unabhängigkeitsrechner: self-sufficiency (tabelleAutarkie.json) and self-consumption share (tabelleEigenverbrauch.json) as 0-1 fractions. Row 0 holds PV power in kWp per MWh/a, column 0 usable storage in kWh per MWh/a, both 0 to 10 in steps of 0.0625; cells are read by bilinear interpolation, as the calculator's own js/unabhaengig.js does.
licence: None stated by HTW Berlin; the calculator page allows embedding anywhere (Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors *). Attribution to HTW Berlin is shown wherever a value from these tables appears.
